      "var": "tail",

    },

      "var": "ptr + tail, alen - tail",

      "role": "sink",
      "note": "Because the empty replacement makes argc differ from the clamped len, value_move is called with a source pointer beyond the array and a negative move count converted to size_t."
    }
  ],
